skills.name: Direct component subtraction
skills.definition: Subtract two aligned numeric values directly — whole-number parts and/or numerators that already share a common denominator.

skills.name: Common denominator conversion
skills.definition: Find the LCD of two unlike denominators and convert both fractions into equivalent fractions with that denominator before subtracting.

skills.name: Borrow/regroup for subtraction
skills.definition: When the fraction-part subtraction would be negative, borrow one whole unit (expressed as denominator/denominator) from the whole part and redo the fraction subtraction.

skills.name: Simplify to lowest terms
skills.definition: Reduce a resulting fraction by dividing numerator and denominator by their greatest common factor to express the answer in lowest terms.

skills.name: Normalize improper mixed-number part
skills.definition: Convert a mixed number whose fractional part has numerator ≥ denominator into standard mixed-number form (extracting whole units) before performing the subtraction.
